entities.name: LADN information
entities.description: Information element containing Local Area Data Network service area information for subscribed DNNs.

entities.name: Valid LADN service areas exist
entities.description: Condition where there are valid LADN service area(s) for the subscribed DNN(s) of the UE in the current registration area.

entities.name: Network includes LADN information IE
entities.description: Network behavior to include the LADN information IE when valid LADN service areas exist.

relations.description: The condition of valid LADN service areas existing establishes the network behavior to include the LADN information IE.
The network inclusion behavior results in the LADN information IE being present.
